model: game-element tree. A node is a GAME ELEMENT the AI docks and builds — not an abstract task. Each carries `element` (what it is), `pseudocode` (the design draft — the orchestrator authors this), `seed` (existing working code to refine, not rewrite), `connects` (edges to other elements, {to, via} = the contract that flows across — the orchestrator indicates these), and `children` (subnodes when complex; a parent greens only when its children + its own keys are green). `dependsOn` = build-order gate (foundations must be green first). Green is DERIVED: leaf mechanic → unit-tested (`node --test`); a scene element → render-verified (swarm_probe eye).
connections_note: ORCHESTRATOR-DEFINED WIRING (read `connects` on each node): shipyard --(a berth design)--> hull --(a spawned unit)--> battle --(win)--> debrief. finder --(join room)--> lobby --(host START)--> battle. Every scene --(entity codes)--> shader+chrome (the render layer). Every module --(SRC string)--> build --(one hook)--> integrate. An AI building one side of a connection may carry its context into the connected undocked node and build the other side (SWARM-GUIDE rule 5).

nodes.element: THE WAR SCENE — fleets fight over capture points
nodes.pseudocode: each seat SPAWNS units from berths at COST from income; income from capture rings (sole-holder ticks ⬡). Units steer to the seat's cursor; GUN tiles fire beams along edge-normal arcs; GEN sustains energy (brownout halves fire). PER-TILE damage: beam→nearest enemy tile, dead tiles shed, route-BFS orphans shear, tile-0 death kills. Intact STAR = super-weapon. Win: hold all rings 30s or eliminate.

seed.note: PRE-POPULATED combat — port + split into children

connects.via: income HUD, spawn strip, brownout marker

children.pseudocode: rings: sole-holder ticks ⬡, contested=neutral, passive trickle; spend income to spawn a berth unit at its cost, at the home dock.
steer to seat cursor (BLOOP, latched); GUN tiles fire beams along edge-normal arcs; GEN sustains, brownout halves fire rate.
beam hits nearest enemy TILE; dead tiles shed; route-BFS from tile 0 over the contact graph shears orphans; tile-0 death kills the unit; intact STAR hole = charged AoE lance, disarms if broken.
hold ALL rings 30s OR eliminate all enemy units + income < cheapest spawn → PW.scene='debrief'.
